reading: Comedian Katherine Ryan described feeling both grief and relief after Russell Brand was convicted of rape and sexual assault.
She said many women had been speaking privately after Thursday’s verdict and described their response as a nuanced mix of emotions.
In an earlier documentary interview with Louis Theroux, Ryan had said there was a “predator” in the entertainment industry.
In 2022, Ryan described naming the man as a “litigious minefield”.
She said she had appeared on a television programme with him and had confronted him directly.
There was speculation that Ryan was referring to her time on Roast Battle with Brand in 2018, but she has not confirmed that she meant him and did not name the programme.
On her podcast, Ryan said the verdict had left her emotionally unsettled and that she was in awe of the survivors.
She stressed that the survivors had come forward despite Brand’s wealth and influence and the prospect of attacks from his fans.
Ryan acknowledged that some justice had been done.
However much justice is done, Ryan said, those who were hurt will continue to live with the consequences.
Brand was convicted on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.
The court acquitted him of two other rape charges and an allegation of attempted indecent assault.
Ahead of Monday’s sentencing, the judge told Brand to expect a substantial custodial term, meaning a lengthy period in prison.
Before the trial, Brand made an unsuccessful bid to have the case dismissed.
His lawyers argued that the publicity following the Dispatches programme was so prejudicial that he could not receive a fair trial.
Police said Brand was also under investigation over further rape allegations made by two women.
Former BBC One controller Lorraine Heggessey questioned how Brand had avoided being held to account for so long.
Heggessey suggested that one factor was Brand’s ability to draw the young viewers many broadcasters covet.

vocabulary.definition: Involving subtle differences or layers, as when several emotions coexist and a single label would oversimplify them.
A situation in which what someone says or does could expose them to legal action, with risks that are difficult to anticipate or manage.
Discussion about what might be true when the available information leaves the answer uncertain.
Feeling deep admiration or respect for someone, here for the courage the survivors showed.
The possibility of a future event that someone has reason to take seriously.
An individual charge in a criminal case that can receive its own verdict.
A formal legal expression for a period of imprisonment imposed as part of a sentence.
Formally ended by a court, here in reference to the outcome Brand unsuccessfully sought before trial.
Likely to undermine the fairness of a legal proceeding, for example by influencing people’s views before they hear the evidence.
Made to answer for one’s conduct and face any consequences that follow.
Strongly want something considered valuable, here an audience of younger viewers.

entries.ja: 微妙な違いやいくつもの側面を含んでいる。たとえば、いくつかの感情が同時にあり、一言で表すと単純化しすぎてしまうような場合をいう。
entries.ko: 미묘한 차이나 여러 층위가 있는 것을 말한다. 예를 들어, 여러 감정을 동시에 느껴 한마디로 표현하면 지나치게 단순해지는 경우가 이에 해당한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 包含细微差别或多个层次，例如几种情绪同时存在，用一个词概括就会把它们说得过于简单。
entries.es: Que presenta diferencias sutiles o varios niveles, como cuando coexisten varias emociones y una sola etiqueta las simplificaría demasiado.
entries.pt-BR: Que envolve diferenças sutis ou várias camadas, como quando várias emoções coexistem e usar um único rótulo para descrevê-las seria simplificar demais.
entries.fr: Qui comporte des différences subtiles ou plusieurs niveaux, comme lorsque plusieurs émotions coexistent et qu’un seul mot pour les décrire serait trop réducteur.
entries.de: Mit feinen Unterschieden oder mehreren Ebenen, etwa wenn mehrere Gefühle gleichzeitig empfunden werden und eine einzige Bezeichnung sie zu stark vereinfachen würde.

entries.ja: 発言や行動をきっかけに法的措置を取られる可能性があり、そのリスクを予測したり対処したりするのが難しい状況。
entries.ko: 자신의 말이나 행동 때문에 법적 조치의 대상이 될 수 있고, 그 위험을 미리 내다보거나 관리하기 어려운 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个人可能因自己的言行而面临诉讼等法律行动，且相关风险难以预料或应对的处境。
entries.es: Situación en la que podrían emprenderse acciones legales contra alguien por lo que diga o haga, con riesgos difíciles de prever o manejar.
entries.pt-BR: Situação em que alguém pode ser alvo de medidas judiciais pelo que diz ou faz, com riscos difíceis de prever ou administrar.
entries.fr: Situation dans laquelle une personne pourrait faire l’objet d’une action en justice en raison de ses propos ou de ses actes, avec des risques difficiles à prévoir ou à gérer.
entries.de: Eine Situation, in der das, was jemand sagt oder tut, rechtliche Schritte gegen diese Person nach sich ziehen könnte und die Risiken schwer vorherzusehen oder zu bewältigen sind.

entries.ja: 手元の情報だけでは答えがはっきりしないときに、何が事実かを推測しながら話し合うこと。
entries.ko: 주어진 정보만으로는 답이 확실하지 않을 때, 무엇이 사실일 수 있는지에 관한 이야기.
entries.zh-Hans: 在现有信息不足以确定答案时，就什么可能是事实展开的讨论。
entries.es: Conversación sobre lo que podría ser cierto cuando la información disponible no permite saber la respuesta con seguridad.
entries.pt-BR: Discussão sobre o que pode ser verdade quando as informações disponíveis não permitem saber a resposta com certeza.
entries.fr: Échange sur ce qui pourrait être vrai quand les informations disponibles ne permettent pas de trancher.
entries.de: Ein Austausch darüber, was wahr sein könnte, wenn sich die Frage anhand der verfügbaren Informationen nicht sicher beantworten lässt.

entries.ja: 誰かに対して深い感嘆や敬意を抱くこと。ここでは、被害を受けた人たちが示した勇気に対する気持ちを指す。
entries.ko: 누군가에게 깊은 감탄이나 존경을 느끼는 것을 말한다. 여기서는 피해를 겪은 사람들이 보여 준 용기에 대한 감정을 가리킨다.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某人深感钦佩或敬重，这里指钦佩或敬重受害者所展现的勇气。
entries.es: Sentir una profunda admiración o un gran respeto por alguien, en este caso por la valentía que mostraron las personas que sufrieron las agresiones.
entries.pt-BR: Sentir profunda admiração ou respeito por alguém, neste caso pela coragem demonstrada pelas pessoas que sofreram as agressões.
entries.fr: Éprouver une profonde admiration ou un grand respect pour quelqu’un, ici pour le courage dont ont fait preuve les personnes qui ont subi les agressions.
entries.de: Tiefe Bewunderung oder großen Respekt für jemanden empfinden, hier für den Mut, den die Betroffenen gezeigt haben.

entries.ja: 将来何かが起こる可能性で、それを真剣に受け止めるだけの理由があるもの。
entries.ko: 앞으로 어떤 일이 일어날 가능성으로, 누군가가 이를 진지하게 받아들일 이유가 있는 경우를 말한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 将来某件事可能发生，而且有人有理由认真看待这种可能性。
entries.es: Posibilidad de que algo ocurra en el futuro, cuando hay motivos para tomar en serio esa posibilidad.
entries.pt-BR: A possibilidade de algo acontecer no futuro, quando há motivos para levar essa possibilidade a sério.
entries.fr: La possibilité qu’un événement se produise à l’avenir, lorsqu’on a des raisons de prendre cette possibilité au sérieux.
entries.de: Die Möglichkeit, dass etwas in der Zukunft geschieht, wenn jemand Grund hat, diese Möglichkeit ernst zu nehmen.

entries.ja: 刑事事件で問われる一つ一つの罪状で、それぞれについて有罪か無罪かを判断できるもの。
entries.ko: 형사 사건에서 유죄인지 무죄인지 따로 판단할 수 있는 개별 혐의 항목.
entries.zh-Hans: 刑事案件中的一项单独指控，可以就这一项作出有罪或无罪的裁决。
entries.es: Cada acusación individual de un proceso penal sobre la que puede emitirse un veredicto por separado.
entries.pt-BR: Uma acusação individual em um processo criminal sobre a qual pode haver um veredito separado.
entries.fr: Une accusation distincte dans une affaire pénale, qui peut faire l’objet d’un verdict séparé.
entries.de: Ein einzelner Anklagepunkt in einem Strafverfahren, über den gesondert entschieden werden kann.

entries.ja: 裁判で言い渡される刑の一部として科される収監期間を指す、正式な法律用語。
entries.ko: 법원이 선고한 형의 일부로 교도소에 수감되는 기간을 가리키는 공식 법률 표현.
entries.zh-Hans: 指作为所判刑罚的一部分而必须服刑的监禁期限的正式法律用语。
entries.es: Expresión jurídica formal que designa un período de encarcelamiento impuesto como parte de una pena.
entries.pt-BR: Expressão jurídica formal para um período de prisão imposto como parte de uma pena.
entries.fr: Expression juridique formelle qui désigne une période d’emprisonnement imposée dans le cadre d’une peine.
entries.de: Ein förmlicher juristischer Ausdruck für einen Zeitraum, den jemand als Teil der verhängten Strafe im Gefängnis verbringen muss.

entries.ja: 裁判所によって正式に打ち切られたこと。ここでは、ブランドが公判前に事件の打ち切りを求めたものの、認められなかったことを指す。
entries.ko: 법원에 의해 공식적으로 종결된 상태를 말한다. 여기서는 브랜드가 재판이 시작되기 전에 사건을 종결해 달라고 요청했지만 받아들여지지 않은 경우를 가리킨다.
entries.zh-Hans: 由法院正式终结。这里指布兰德在庭审前曾试图让法院终结案件，但未能成功。
entries.es: Dado por terminado formalmente por un tribunal. Aquí se refiere al cierre del caso que Brand intentó conseguir sin éxito antes del juicio.
entries.pt-BR: Encerrado formalmente por um tribunal. Aqui, refere-se ao encerramento do caso que Brand tentou obter, sem sucesso, antes do julgamento.
entries.fr: Clos officiellement par un tribunal. Il s’agit ici de la clôture de l’affaire que Brand a tenté en vain d’obtenir avant le procès.
entries.de: Von einem Gericht förmlich beendet. Hier geht es um die Einstellung des Verfahrens, die Brand vor dem Prozess erfolglos beantragt hatte.

entries.ja: 裁判などの法的手続きの公正さを損なうおそれがある。たとえば、証拠が示される前に、人々の見方に影響を与えるような場合をいう。
entries.ko: 법적 절차의 공정성을 해칠 가능성이 큰 것을 말한다. 예를 들어, 사람들이 증거를 접하기 전에 그들의 판단에 영향을 주는 경우가 있다.
entries.zh-Hans: 很可能损害司法程序的公正性，例如在人们接触证据之前就影响他们的看法。
entries.es: Que probablemente perjudique la equidad de un procedimiento judicial, por ejemplo, al influir en la opinión de las personas antes de que conozcan las pruebas.
entries.pt-BR: Que tende a tornar um processo judicial menos justo, por exemplo, ao influenciar a opinião das pessoas antes que conheçam as provas.
entries.fr: Qui risque de compromettre l’équité d’une procédure judiciaire, par exemple en influençant l’opinion des personnes avant qu’elles aient pris connaissance des preuves.
entries.de: Was die Fairness eines Gerichtsverfahrens zu beeinträchtigen droht, etwa indem es die Ansichten von Menschen beeinflusst, bevor sie die Beweise kennen.

entries.ja: 自分の行動について責任を問われ、それによって生じる結果を引き受けるよう求められること。
entries.ko: 자신의 행동에 대해 책임을 지라는 요구를 받고, 그에 따른 결과가 있다면 감당해야 하는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 被要求为自己的行为负责，并承担由此产生的任何后果。
entries.es: Verse obligado a responder por la propia conducta y afrontar las consecuencias que se deriven de ella.
entries.pt-BR: Ter de responder pela própria conduta e enfrentar as consequências que dela decorrerem.
entries.fr: Être obligé de répondre de sa conduite et de faire face aux conséquences qui en découlent, s’il y en a.
entries.de: Für das eigene Verhalten zur Verantwortung gezogen werden und sich den Folgen stellen müssen, die sich daraus ergeben.

entries.ja: 価値があると考えられるものを強く欲しがること。ここでは、より若い視聴者層を獲得したいと強く望むことを指す。
entries.ko: 가치 있다고 여기는 것을 간절히 원한다는 뜻이다. 여기서는 더 젊은 시청자층을 확보하기를 간절히 바란다는 뜻이다.
entries.zh-Hans: 非常想得到被认为有价值的东西，这里指非常想吸引较年轻的观众群体。
entries.es: Desear intensamente algo que se considera valioso, en este caso contar con un público de espectadores más jóvenes.
entries.pt-BR: Querer muito algo considerado valioso, neste caso, atrair um público de espectadores mais jovens.
entries.fr: Désirer vivement quelque chose que l’on juge précieux, ici un public de téléspectateurs plus jeunes.
entries.de: Etwas, das als wertvoll gilt, unbedingt haben wollen. Hier geht es darum, ein jüngeres Fernsehpublikum zu gewinnen.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
